requirements.title: Restore reproducible performance baseline
acceptance: scripts/check_env.py is aligned with runtime dependencies

requirements.title: Reduce live/paper strategy on_bar recomputation
acceptance: 3 real strategies reach at least 2000 bars/s on synthetic benchmark

requirements.title: Reduce validation duplicate work
acceptance: duplicate slice/param evaluations are cached inside a run

constraints.summary: QuantFlow is CLI-first; performance evidence should come from CLI, pytest, benchmarks, and Prometheus metrics.
Keep generate_signals(df) as the research/backtest API and prove parity for incremental live paths.
Implementation may choose strategy-local state, shared rolling helpers, or a stateful indicator engine.

domain.system_type: Python CLI crypto quantitative trading system

non_goals.title: Frontend performance
non_goals.rationale: No frontend exists in this repository.

non_goals.title: Major data lake migration
non_goals.rationale: First wave can optimize append and query behavior without a full storage rewrite.

insights.summary: The runtime bottleneck is strategy recomputation, not session dispatch or paper order execution.
CPCV/WFO optimization work multiplies quickly and needs staged modes plus caching.
Performance work should begin by restoring benchmark passability in the documented environment.

open_questions.question: Should the first implementation use strategy-local state or a shared IndicatorState helper?
options: shared helper for consistency across strategies

open_questions.question: Should parallelism start with Optuna n_jobs or split-level process execution?
